name: Factory Suite Pro - Complete Multi-Sheet AI Workflow

parameters.query: SELECT id, name, category, stock, unit, cost, threshold, color, packets, poNumber, invoiceNo, location FROM materials ORDER BY category ASC, stock DESC;

SELECT z.Lot_Number, z.Garment_Type, z.Style, z.Total_Pieces, z.Zip_Selections, z.Zip_Quality_Data, z.Supplier_Name AS zip_supplier, z.po_number AS zip_po, d.Dori_Selections, d.Total_Pieces AS dori_pieces, d.Supplier_Name AS dori_supplier, d.po_number AS dori_po FROM zip z LEFT JOIN doori d ON z.Lot_Number = d.Lot_Number ORDER BY z.id DESC;
